title: Re-Measure Delay Rates: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Field Scheduling Standard
content:
Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, the longer a re-reported crack waits for its re-measurement, the lower the re-measure delay multiplier applied to the program's reinspection fee in the visit charge of the re-measurement.

**Rule.** The re-measure delay multiplier counts the calendar days from the date the re-reported item was filed to the date of the re-measurement, the filing date itself not counted: more than 14 days take 0.50; 8 to 14 days take 0.80; 7 days or fewer take 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Calendar days from filing to re-measurement | Re-measure delay multiplier |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | 1.00 |
| 8 | 0.80 |
| 14 | 0.80 |
| 15 or more | 0.50 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical dates).** Filed 1 April, re-measured 8 April: 7 days, 1.00. Re-measured 9 April: 8 days, 0.80. Re-measured 15 April: 14 days, 0.80. Re-measured 16 April: 15 days, 0.50.

The filing date is the date the re-measured claim item was filed, as the item's own record shows it; the re-measurement date is the date of the inspection that found the crack within tolerance again.
